d: 🚀 We're Hiring | BOQ Senior Associate - KSA
At Americana Restaurants, we operate leading global brands across the Kingdom, including KFC, Hardee's, Pizza Hut, Krispy Kreme, TGI Fridays, and Peet's Coffee.
We are looking for an experienced Saudi quantity surveyor to join our Design team.
Produce accurate bills of quantities for new store openings and remodels in line with the Design team's drawings and requirements.
Prepare high-level and detailed cost estimates to support project budgeting and approvals.
Read and interpret architectural, interior design, civil, and MEP drawings to quantify scope precisely.
Ensure Americana design and specification standards are implemented and maintained across every BOQ.
Propose value engineering options that reduce cost without compromising brand standards or quality.
Benchmark material and service rates against current market prices across the Kingdom.
Support review of contractor submissions and variation claims against the issued BOQ.
Reflect local authority and municipal specification requirements in scopes and quantities.
Work closely with the Design, Construction, and Real Estate teams, and with vendors and suppliers.
Support special projects requiring dedicated analysis and reporting.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil or Mechanical).
6-8 years of experience as a Quantity Surveyor.
Excellent architectural and interior design drawing reading skills.
Strong knowledge of civil and interior works specifications, and good knowledge of MEP systems.
Good working knowledge of AutoCAD and advanced Microsoft Excel.
Familiarity with local authority specification requirements in the Kingdom.
Prior experience with retail or F&B brands is an advantage.
Analytical thinking • Attention to detail • Meeting deadlines • Managing multiple projects • Independent, high-quality delivery • Clear written and verbal communication.
🇸🇦 This opportunity is open to Saudi nationals only, in line with our commitment to developing national talent and supporting Saudi Vision 2030.

Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.

The British School of Bahrain (BSB) is a multi-award-winning school and one of the top international schools in Bahrain, educating children with demonstrable success for over 30 years. The school is rated “Outstanding” by Bahrain Quality Assurance (BQA) and British School Overseas (BSO).

The British School of Bahrain is renowned for offering the best holistic UK-based education within Bahrain. BSB’s core values of Excellence, Responsibility & Individuality underpin everything that we do and are epitomised by our three pillars of Academics, Sports and the Arts.

BSB delivers high-quality British education to around 2,600 students aged 3 to 18 years and employs 306 full-time staff representing 31 different countries who are carefully handpicked. BSB is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. Successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check/ICPC or equivalent and satisfactory pre-employment references.

BSB is a vibrant and enjoyable place to work, and is renowned for its pedagogy, staff development and academic success. The value we place on individuality is evident in our inclusive and innovative teaching approach. Our curriculum is based on the National Curriculum for England and Wales, with some adaptations to the local context and offers IGCSE, BTEC and A-Level examinations. Our aim is to provide our graduating students with a passport to the best universities, colleges and careers around the world.
We are seeking to appoint a Teacher of Physical Education to start in August, 2027.
q: A degree and PGCE or B.Ed or the equivalent. The degree must be in the subject taught or a closely related subject
Experience teaching the British curriculum up to GCSE and A-level students is highly desirable
Confidence with the use of ICT in teaching
Enhanced disclosure from the DBS or equivalent, and who are committed to the welfare of all children
High expectations and aspirations for all students
A commitment to the overall development of young people
An open-minded approach to their work, and willing to learn and develop
A demonstrable love for what they do and a proven track record
To be considered for this position, you will need to meet our qualifications and experience requirements.

In return, we offer an attractive expatriate remuneration package, including a competitive tax-free salary, housing allowance, health insurance, annual flight and relocation assistance, and 2 free places for children.

Inspired Education Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practices and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.

r: Creating Engaging Lessons: Plan and deliver lessons that inspire and challenge all students and are in line with the school's curriculum, policies, and external assessment requirements. You will individualise and differentiate learning, ensuring each student is stretched, supported, and makes outstanding progress.

Supporting and Assessing Progress: Regularly assess students' in-class and at-home learning, providing targeted feedback to drive progress and ensure all students are challenged and supported in reaching their potential.

Building a Positive Learning Environment: Establish a classroom and school environment where students are invested in each other's flourishing, feel valued and supported, and are ready to take risks in their learning.

Collaborating and Sharing Best Practices: Work closely with colleagues as an active member of our learning community, sharing best practices, collaborating with colleagues, and dedicating yourself to your own professional development to ensure the highest standard of education for our students.

Contributing to School Life: Play an active role in the school's co-curricular programme, helping to create a well-rounded, enriching educational experience. From leading clubs to contributing to whole school initiatives, you will help shape the broader life of the school.

Collaborating with Parents: Maintain open and constructive communication with parents, building strong partnerships that support students' progress so that each child feels like an individual, well-known and respected.

d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

Reporting to the Regional Visual Merchandiser, your role will be to implement and maintain the M&S brand image within the store, ensuring visual consistency. You will provide the customer with the most inspirational shopping experience possible. You will also be responsible for maintaining effective communication with store colleagues and the RVM / Manager VM.

Join us and be part of The Heart of Tomorrow.
